name: Setup Bazel environment
description: Setup a Bazel environment, including Bazelisk and fine-grained caching

bazelisk-version.description: The Bazelisk version to download and use if necessary

bazelrc.description: Extra contents to write to user .bazelrc

disk-cache.description: Cache actions outputs based on BUILD

external-cache.description: Cache external 10MB+ repositories based on MODULE.bazel/WORKSPACE

google-credentials.description: Google Cloud account key for remote cache

module-root.description: Bazel module root directory. Default is `.`

output-base.description: Bazel output base directory. Default is $HOME/.cache/bazel (POSIX) or D:/_bazel (Windows)

token.description: GitHub token to query Bazelisk releases
